script.text: Yusei escaped Trudge and the other Sector Security forces, making his way into New Domino City.
There, he came face to face with his rival Jack Atlas. Jack had stolen Yusei's ace card Stardust Dragon.
Using Stardust Dragon, Jack was able to escape Satellite and establish himself as the undefeated Turbo Dueling champion of New Domino City.
Welcome to the Kaiba Dome! This duel dome is impressive, isn't it? Television just doesn't do it justice.
Now imagine it filled with thousands of adoring fans chanting your name and cheering you on. But that’s something you’re never going to experience, Yusei.

Because after this duel, the only people cheering you on will be your loser friends back in the Satellite! And that’s if they don’t all turn their backs on you once you return without their Stardust Dragon!
You're going to regret ever coming here because I'm going to beat you with your own card!
